tool.name: Install example reference
tool.description: create and register a tiny reference file

configfiles.configfile:
import json import sys from pathlib import Path
output = Path(sys.argv[1]) model_id = sys.argv[2] if model_id != "model1": sys.exit("Unknown example reference: " + model_id) params = json.loads(output.read_text()) directory = Path(params["output_data"][0]["extra_files_path"]) directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) (directory / "reference.txt").write_text("example reference data\n") entry = {"value": model_id, "name": "Example reference", "path": "reference.txt"} output.write_text(json.dumps({"data_tables": {"models": [entry]}}))

param.name: model
param.label: Reference ID
param.help: This synthetic example supports model1 only.

validator.message: Use letters, digits or underscores only.

tool.help:
Creates a one-line synthetic reference and returns native data-manager JSON for the `models` table. Its registration configuration moves the file into Galaxy's reference-data directory and records the resolved path.
This CI fixture downloads no assets and installs no model weights.
